blocks.text: Grade 12 高频词汇 001–100
misconstrue /.miskən'struː/ v.t. 误解, 曲解；[法] 曲解, 误解, 误会
I know well enough that a step like that is improper and might be misconstrued.
中文语境：我很清楚这样的步骤是不恰当的，并且可能会被误解
inextricable /in'ekstrəkəbl/ adj. 逃脱不掉的, 解不开的, 无法解决的

What was left of him, rotted beneath what was left of the nightshirt, had become inextricable from the bed in which he lay; and upon him and upon the pillow beside him lay that even coating of the patient and biding dust.
中文语境：他剩下的东西，在睡衣剩下的部分下面腐烂了，已经与他躺着的床上密不可分；他身上和旁边的枕头上都沾满了病人身上的一层均匀的灰尘
earthiness /'əːθinis/ n. 土质, 土性, 粗陋, 朴实
It was as if she demanded more than ever the recognition of her dignity as the last Grierson; as if it had wanted that touch of earthiness to reaffirm her imperviousness.
中文语境：就好像她比以往任何时候都更要求承认她作为最后一个格里森人的尊严；仿佛它想要那一抹泥土来重申她的不受影响
artery /'ɑːtəri/ n. 动脉, 干道, 要道；[医] 动脉
Brummett and colleagues reported in 2001 that among adults with coronary artery disease, the mortality rate was 2.4 times higher among those who were socially isolated.
中文语境：Brummett 及其同事在 2001 年报告说，患有冠状动脉疾病的成年人中，与社会隔离的人的死亡率高出 2.4 倍
hypochondriac /,haipəu'kɔndriæk/ n. 疑病症患者, 忧郁症患者；[医] 疑病患者, 疑病的, 季肋部的

For me at least-in the circumstances then surrounding me-there arose out of the pure abstractions which the hypochondriac contrived to throw upon his canvas, an intensity of intolerable awe, no shadow of which felt I ever yet in the contemplation of the certainly glowing yet too concrete reveries of Fuseli.
中文语境：至少对我来说--在当时我周围的环境中--忧郁症患者设法在画布上投射出一种纯粹的抽象，一种令人难以忍受的敬畏的强度，在沉思富塞利那确实闪闪发光但过于具体的遐想时，我从未感受到过这种敬畏的影子
disinclination /.disinkli'neʃən/ n. 不愿, 不感兴趣, 厌恶
Sloth(noun)disinclination to action or labor 3.
中文语境：懒惰（名词）不愿行动或劳动 3.
rhetoric /'retərik/ n. 修辞, 修辞学, 雄辩(术)
Histories make men wise; poets witty; the mathematics subtle; natural philosophy 7 8 deep; moral grave; logic and rhetoric able to contend.
中文语境：历史使人明智；历史使人明智；历史使人明智。诗人机智；数学精妙；自然哲学7 8深；道德坟墓；逻辑和修辞能够抗衡
communicable /kə'mjuːnikəbl/ adj. 可传达的, 会传染的, 爱说话的；[医] 有传染性的

The warnings involved fertility clinics that didn't test donors of eggs and sperm for communicable diseases; researchers who didn't follow rules designed to protect patients who volunteer for trials of drugs and devices; doctors who pushed dubious treatments and supplements to unwitting customers; and...
中文语境：这些警告涉及生育诊所，这些诊所没有对卵子和精子捐献者进行传染病检测；研究人员不遵守旨在保护自愿参加药物和设备试验的患者的规则；医生向不知情的顾客推销可疑的治疗方法和补充剂；还有......
cardiologist n. 心脏病学家；[医] 心[脏]病学家
Rita Redberg, a cardiologist at the University of California, San Francisco, and editor of the JAMA Internal Medicine journal, said a warning letter often signals an alarming issue.
中文语境：加州大学旧金山分校的心脏病专家、《美国医学会杂志内科医学》杂志编辑丽塔·雷德伯格 (Rita Redberg) 表示，警告信通常预示着一个令人担忧的问题
oversight /'əuvəsait/ n. 勘漏, 失察, 失败, 照料；[经] 监督权
Department of Health and Human Services, which administers the data bank, and eight members of a House subcommittee with oversight of DHSS.
中文语境：管理数据库的卫生与公众服务部以及负责监督 DHSS 的众议院小组委员会的八名成员
negligent /'neglidʒənt/ adj. 疏忽的, 粗心的, 不在意的

improper, illegal, or negligent professional activity or treatment, especially by a medical practitioner, lawyer, or public official And the information is off limits to those who are most at risk: Patients.
中文语境：不当、非法或疏忽的专业活动或治疗，尤其是由执业医师、律师或公职人员进行的且该信息禁止向最危险的人群开放：患者
stringent /'strindʒənt/ adj. 迫切的, 严厉的, 银根紧的；[医] 约束的, 紧迫的
A more stringent approach would be to prohibit doctors who have been barred from funding in one state from getting any Medicaid money in another.
中文语境：一种更严格的方法是禁止在一个州被禁止获得资助的医生在另一个州获得任何医疗补助资金
unwitting /.ʌn'witiŋ/ adj. 不知情的, 没有意识到的, 不知不觉的

...designed to protect patients who volunteer for trials of drugs and devices; doctors who pushed dubious treatments and supplements to unwitting customers; and a mammography clinic faulted for inadequate quality control testing.
中文语境：...旨在保护自愿参加药物和设备试验的患者；医生向不知情的顾客推销可疑的治疗方法和补充剂；一家乳房X光检查诊所因质量控制测试不足而受到指责
pedagogue /'pedəgɒg/ n. 小学教师, 教员, 学究

Thus, by divers little makeshifts, in that ingenious way which is commonly denominated "by hook and by crook," the worthy pedagogue got on tolerably enough, and was thought, by all who understood nothing of the labor of headwork, to have a wonderfully easy life of it.
中文语境：因此，通过各种小小的权宜之计，以通常被称为"不择手段"的巧妙方式，这位可敬的教育家过得还算可以，并且被所有对脑力劳动一无所知的人认为，过着极其轻松的生活
ratiocination /.rætiɒsi'neiʃən/ n. 推理, 推论

...in the state." The cautious old gentleman knit his brows tenfold closer after this explanation, being sorely 60 61 puzzled by the ratiocination of the syllogism, while, methought, the one in pepper-and-salt eyed him with something of a triumphant leer.
中文语境：...在国家里。"听完这个解释，谨慎的老绅士把眉毛拧得更紧了，60 61 对三段论的推理感到非常困惑，而我想，那个穿着胡椒和盐的人用一种胜利的斜视看着他
ingratiating /in'greiʃieitiŋ/ adj. 逢迎的, 迎合的
He laid aside, too, all the dominant dignity and absolute sway with which he lorded it in his little empire, the school, and became wonderfully gentle and ingratiating.
中文语境：他也抛弃了他在他的小帝国--学校中所拥有的所有主导尊严和绝对影响力，变得异常温柔和讨好
portentous /pɒː'tentəs/ adj. 前兆的, 不吉的, 可惊的, 自大的

He would delight them equally by his anecdotes of witchcraft, and of the direful omens and portentous sights and sounds in the air, which prevailed in the earlier times of Connecticut; and would frighten them woefully with speculations upon comets and shooting stars; and with the alarming fact 21.
中文语境：他会用他的巫术轶事以及康涅狄格州早期盛行的可怕预兆、不祥的景象和空气中的声音来让他们同样高兴。并会用对彗星和流星的猜测来吓坏他们；以及令人震惊的事实21
crestfallen /'krest.fɒːlən/ adj. 垂头丧气的, 意气沮丧的, 气馁的

It was the very witching time of night that Ichabod, heavy-hearted and crestfallen, pursued his travels homewards, along the sides of the lofty hills which rise above Tarry Town, and which he had traversed so cheerily in the afternoon.
中文语境：那是一个令人着迷的夜晚，伊卡博德心情沉重，垂头丧气，沿着塔里镇上方的高山两侧踏上回家的路，他在下午愉快地穿过了这些山
antiquarian /.ænti'kwєəriən/ n. 古文物收藏家, 古董商；adj. 古文物的, 古文物研究的

Alien to the impertinences of the world, he only lifted his antiquarian eyes and murmured something in his dialect when Father Gonzaga went into the chicken coop and said good morning to him in Latin.
中文语境：当冈萨加神父走进鸡舍，用拉丁语向他道早安时，他对这个世界的无礼行为格格不入，只是抬起他那双古色古香的眼睛，用方言低声说了些什么
providential /.prɒvi'denʃəl/ adj. 天意的, 根据神意的, 天佑的, 幸运的
Those meager letters might have come and gone until the end of time if a providential event had not put an end to the priest's tribulations.
中文语境：如果神父的苦难没有因天意而结束，那么这些微不足道的信件可能会一直来来去去，直到时间的尽头
heartrending /'hɑːt.rendiŋ/ adj. 令人心碎的, 悲惨的
What was most heartrending, however, was not her outlandish shape but the sincere affliction with which she recounted the details of her misfortune.
中文语境：然而，最令人心碎的不是她古怪的外表，而是她在讲述自己不幸的细节时所表现出的真诚的痛苦
ingenuous /in'dʒenjuəs/ adj. 坦白的, 正直的, 天真的
Then he came out of the chicken coop and in a brief sermon warned the curious against the risks of being ingenuous.
中文语境：然后他从鸡舍里出来，在一次简短的布道中警告好奇者不要表现得天真
cataclysm /'kætəklizm/ n. 大洪水, 地震, (社会政治的)大变动；[医] 渗出, 渗液, 猝变, 聚变

Although many thought that his reaction had not been one of rage but of pain, from then on they were careful not to annoy him, because the majority understood that his passivity was not that of a hero taking his ease but that of a cataclysm in repose.
中文语境：尽管许多人认为他的反应不是愤怒而是痛苦，但从那时起，他们就小心翼翼地不惹恼他，因为大多数人都明白，他的被动不是英雄悠闲自在的表现，而是一场安息中的灾难
quotidian /kwɒ'tidiən/ adj. 每日的, 每日发作的, 司空见惯的, 平凡的；n. 日发热

As the writer Michael Lewis observed in his book "Next: The Future Just Happened," children see the Net as a transformational device that lets them discard quotidian identities for more glamorous ones.
中文语境：正如作家迈克尔·刘易斯在他的著作《下一步：未来刚刚发生》中所观察到的那样，孩子们将网络视为一种变革性的工具，可以让他们抛弃平凡的身份，转而追求更迷人的身份
gregarious /gre'gєəriəs/ adj. 社交的, 群居的
Studies show that gregarious, well-connected people actually lost friends, and experienced symptoms of loneliness and depression, after joining discussion groups and other activities.
中文语境：研究表明，善于交际、人脉广泛的人在参加讨论小组和其他活动后实际上会失去朋友，并出现孤独和抑郁的症状
hermetic /həː'metik/ adj. 奥妙的, 密封的, 不透气的, 不漏气的, 与外界隔绝的；[计] 全密封的

This hermetic existence has left many of these teenagers with nonexistent social skills - a point widely noted in stories about the computer geeks who rose to prominence in the early days of Silicon Valley.
中文语境：这种与世隔绝的生活让许多青少年缺乏社交技能--这一点在硅谷早期崭露头角的计算机极客的故事中被广泛提及
glamorous /'glæmərəs/ adj. 富有魅力的, 迷人的

As the writer Michael Lewis observed in his book "Next: The Future Just Happened," children see the Net as a transformational device that lets them discard quotidian identities for more glamorous ones.
中文语境：正如作家迈克尔·刘易斯在他的著作《下一步：未来刚刚发生》中所观察到的那样，孩子们将网络视为一种变革性的工具，可以让他们抛弃平凡的身份，转而追求更迷人的身份
impalpable /im'pælpəbl/ adj. 不可触知的, 不能感知的, 难以理解的；[医] 不可接触的, 极细微的
The sun with its specks of planets, its dust of planetoids, and its impalpable comets, swims in a vacant immensity that almost defeats the imagination.
中文语境：太阳及其行星的斑点、小行星的尘埃以及难以捉摸的彗星，在几乎无法想象的空旷无垠中游动
steadiness /'stedinis/ n. 稳健, 坚定, 不变

The star grew-it grew with a terrible steadiness hour after hour, a little larger each hour, a little nearer the midnight zenith, and brighter and brighter, until it had turned night into a second day.
中文语境：星星长大了--它一小时又一小时地以可怕的稳定性长大，每小时都变大一点，离午夜天顶更近一点，而且越来越亮，直到把黑夜变成第二天
expediency /ik'spiːdjənsi/ n. 权宜, 方便, 私利
The abiding concern of this administration has been one of political expediency rather than the needs of man's nature.
中文语境：本届政府始终关注的是政治权宜之计，而不是人性的需要
candidacy /'kændidəsi/ n. 候选人的地位, 候选资格；[法] 候选人的身份, 资格
Announcer: On January 25th, 1972, representative Shirley Chisholm of New York City announced her candidacy for the Democratic presidential nomination in 1972.
中文语境：播音员：1972年1月25日，纽约市众议员雪莉·奇泽姆宣布竞选1972年民主党总统候选人提名
rekindle /.riː'kindl/ v.t. 再点火, 重新激起；v.i. 重新燃烧
Fellow Americans, we have looked in vain to the Nixon administration for the courage, the spirit, the character, and the words to lift us, to bring out the best in us, to rekindle in each of us 1.
中文语境：美国同胞们，我们徒劳地指望尼克松政府提供勇气、精神、品格和言辞来鼓舞我们，激发我们最好的一面，重新点燃我们每个人的热情1
receptive /ri'septiv/ adj. 能接纳的；[医] 接受的, 感受的

What we are entering - we are entering a new era, in which we must, as Americans, demand stature and size from our national leadership - leadership which is fresh, leadership which is open, and leadership which is receptive to the problems of all Americans.
中文语境：我们正在进入一个新时代，作为美国人，我们必须要求我们的国家领导层具有地位和规模--新鲜的领导层、开放的领导层以及能够接受所有美国人问题的领导层
stipulate /'stipjuleit/ v. 规定, 保证

[...] I just want to say this, and it's very important for all Americans to recognize: the United States Constitution stipulates that anyone that is 35 years of age or over and is a natural born citizen can run for the presidency.
中文语境：[...]我只想说这一点，对于所有美国人来说，认识到这一点非常重要：美国宪法规定，任何年满35岁或以上并且是天生公民的人都可以竞选总统
pertain /pə'tein/ v.i. 从属于, 关于, 涉及, 附属, 适合, 相称；[法] 属于, 从属, 附属

And I will - legislation that pertains to daycare centers, education, social services, mental services - the kind of legislation that has to do with the conservation and preservation of the most important resources that any nation has, and that is its human resources.
中文语境：我将 - 与日托中心、教育、社会服务、心理服务有关的立法 - 这种立法与保护和保存任何国家拥有的最重要的资源有关，即人力资源
muted adj. 变弱了的, 变柔和了的
I muted my mike and kept watch for most of the night.
中文语境：我把麦克风静音，并观察了大半夜
intransigent /in'trænsidʒənt/ adj. 非妥协性的；n. 不妥协的人
We tend to think of it as an intransigent given.
中文语境：我们倾向于认为这是一个不妥协的事实
castigate /'kæstigeit/ v.t. 惩罚, 苛评, 修订
And to be castigating China for doing that which the West did in the 19th century, smacks of hypocrisy.
中文语境：指责中国做了西方在 19 世纪所做的事情，有点虚伪
delectation /diːlek'teiʃən/ n. 愉快, 欢乐

And therefore, if any two men desire the same thing which nevertheless they cannot both enjoy, they become enemies; and, in the way to their end, which is principally their own conservation and sometimes their delectation only, endeavour to destroy or subdue one another.
中文语境：因此，如果任何两个人渴望同样的东西，但他们无法同时享受，他们就会成为敌人；并且，在达到目的的过程中，主要是为了保护自己，有时只是为了取悦，而努力摧毁或征服彼此
augmentation /.ɒːgmen'teiʃən/ n. 增加, 增长, 增加物；[医] 增进, 增加
And by consequence, such augmentation of dominion over men being necessary to a man's conservation, it ought to be allowed him.
中文语境：因此，这种对人类的统治权的增强对于人类的保护是必要的，所以应该允许他这样做
machination /mæki'neiʃən/ n. 阴谋, 图谋, 策划；[法] 诡计, 奸计, 阴谋

For, as to the strength of body, the weakest has strength enough to kill the strongest, 2 "Lesser Town Square" by Miroslav Petrasko is either by secret machination or by 3 licensed under CC BY-NC-ND 2.0.
中文语境：因为，就身体的力量而言，最弱的人有足够的力量杀死最强的人，2 Miroslav Petrasko 的"小城镇广场"要么是秘密策划的，要么是通过 CC BY-NC-ND 2.0 许可的 3
commodious /kə'məudjəs/ adj. 宽敞的, 方便的

...is uncertain, and consequently no culture of the earth, no navigation nor use of the commodities that may be imported by sea, no commodious building, no instruments of moving and removing such things as require much force, no knowledge of the face of the earth; no account of time, no arts, no letters, no society, and, which is worst of all,...
中文语境：...是不确定的，因此没有地球文化，没有航行或使用可以通过海上进口的商品，没有宽敞的建筑物，没有移动和移走需要很大力量的东西的工具，没有对地球表面的了解；不考虑时间，不考虑艺术，不考虑文学，不考虑社会，而且，最糟糕的是......
overawe /.əuvər'ɒː/ v.t. 威慑, 吓服
Again, men have no pleasure, but on the contrary a great deal of grief, in keeping company where there is no power able to overawe them all.
中文语境：再说一遍，当人们在没有力量能够威慑所有人的地方结伴时，他们不会感到快乐，反而会感到极大的悲伤
latent /'leitnt/ adj. 潜伏性的, 隐藏的；n. 隐约指纹
And when our first crop of boys turned 18, the pandemic that had been latent so long blossomed in their blood.
中文语境：当我们的第一批男孩年满 18 岁时，潜伏已久的流行病在他们的血液中绽放
paragon /'pærəgən/ n. 杰出典范, 完人, 完美之物
The last girls were in his class and they glowed with a sickly sheen, they were upheld as paragons.
中文语境：最后的女孩们在他的班级里，她们散发着病态的光泽，她们被尊为典范
tread /tred/ n. 踏, 步态, 梯级, 交尾, 鞋底；v.i. 踏, 行走, 交尾；v.t. 踩, 踏, 践踏, 跳(舞)
Kept treading - treading - till it seemed
中文语境：一直踩--踩--直到看起来
elasticity /i.læs'tisiti/ n. 弹力, 弹性；[化] 弹性
...they can ride at last who shall have earned their fare, that is, if they survive so long, but they will probably have lost their elasticity and desire to travel by that time.
中文语境：...他们终于可以骑车了，也就是说，如果他们活了这么久，他们就应该赢得车费，但到那时他们可能已经失去了旅行的弹性和欲望
evangelist /i'vændʒilist/ n. 福音传道者, 圣经新约福音书的作者
in a minute does not carry the most important messages; he is not an evangelist, nor does he come round eating locusts and wild honey.
中文语境：一分钟内不携带最重要的消息；他不是传福音的人，也不是来吃蝗虫和野蜜的
accrue /ə'kruː/ v.i. 自然增加, 产生；[经] 应计, 产生, 出现
Compound interest refers to the loan interest paid on the principal (original) and accrued (gained) interest.
中文语境：复利是指本金（原）和应计（所得）利息所支付的贷款利息
predicament /pri'dikəmənt/ n. 处境, 穷境, 困局

Either is in such a predicament as the man who was earnest to be introduced to a distinguished deaf woman, but when he was presented, and one end of her ear trumpet was put into his hand, had nothing to say.
中文语境：要么陷入这样的困境，就像一个男人热切地想被介绍给一位杰出的聋哑女人，但当他被介绍给他时，她的耳喇叭的一端放在他的手里，却无话可说
